newsitem.title: USA: Equitable says weather, natgas hurt Q1 net.
newsitem.headline: Equitable says weather, natgas hurt Q1 net.

text.p: Equitable Resources Inc on Friday said warmer weather and lower natural gas production hurt its first quarter results.

"Earnings for the quarter largely reflect the seasonal nature of the business and despite warmer weather and lower production, earnings for the quarter remain close to our original business plan," said chief executive Fred Abnew.
The weather was three percent warmer than the 10-year normal and 11.9 percent warmer than the same period last year, the company said.

Equitable also said natgas production decreased by 22 percent. Volumes were off 3.7 billion cubic feet (Bcf) compared with last year, principally due to lower production from the Gulf Coast region. Oil production also declined by about nine percent compared with the 1996 quarter.
Prices for produced natural gas averaged $2.26 per thousand cubic feet (Mcf) down from $2.36 per Mcf for the same period last year, the company said.
Equitable Resources reported first quarter net income declined to $27.8 million, or $0.78 per share from $38.7 million or $1.11 per share for the March 1996 quarter.
